what: Several photo plates are stacked in one spot, with the stack pinned at screen center (top on phones), scrolling 1.3x screen height per plate. When scroll is 17px before the next plate’s position, the next plate rises from 40% below over .4s power3.out and the previous plate is pushed 40% up while fading to .15 (the handoff runs on time, with only the threshold tied to scroll, and reverses when scrolled back). The side list rows (pills) point to the current plate. Pressing one jumps straight to that plate and scrolls to its spot over .6s power3.out. The heading turns on over .2s only while pinned.

options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Panels to stack (two or more) — stacked in the same spot with position:absolute
options.[data-fx-part=nav]: List rows that point to each panel — the current panel gets is-active, clicking jumps to that panel (optional)
options.[data-fx-part=pin]: Inner panel to pin (default: the part element itself)
options.per: Scroll used per panel (screen-height multiple), default 1.3
options.move: Distance in and out (% of panel height), default 40
options.threshold: How many px before the next plate’s spot to flip, default 17
options.navdur: Scroll length to that spot when a list item is clicked (s), default .6
options.start: Pin start (ScrollTrigger) — default is center center on wide screens, top top below 768px

note: Page turns are not tied to scroll — they run for .4s the moment a threshold is crossed (as in the original, no other turn is accepted while one is running). On phones, once the board covers the whole screen, dragging over it still scrolls the page — touch is not blocked.
